set.body:
## Scope
Separate frequent monitoring from broad campaign refresh. Add scheduler, usage, artifact/marker, and telemetry collector adapters that batch known work, use separate cadences, persist continuation, and publish observation evidence/gaps to the journal.

## Acceptance criteria
- Collection reads known work in batches and uses independent scheduler, usage, artifact, and telemetry cadences; it does not run full campaign refresh or scan all outputs for every viewer request.
- Initial limits are enforced and configurable: scheduler roughly every 30 seconds with jitter for at most 1,000 known ids; usage no faster than 60 seconds; at most eight remote calls/host/pass, ten second reads, 1,024 output contracts, 64 MiB hashing, three unit log excerpts, and two host workers.
- Continuation and per-source freshness survive restart; a source timeout, authentication loss, host sleep, or budget truncation becomes a timestamped observation gap rather than stale success.
- Collection shares scheduler queries among viewers of the same host/work set and records the observed scope and sampling limits.
- Tests assert remote-call count, byte/read limits, continuation after interruption, source-specific cadences, and absence of state mutation.
set.title: A3.1: implement budgeted read-only collection with persisted continuation
